style: Warm, joyful hand-painted storybook illustration in the look of a 2D animated family film: soft painterly brush strokes, rounded friendly shapes, bright summery colours, warm golden light, gentle shadows, cosy and happy, cinematic widescreen composition. The animals are always the same: the little mouse, the big bear and the little birds exactly as in their reference sheets. No people, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders.

cast.mouse: a tiny cute brown field mouse with big round ears, a pink nose, big shiny eyes and a long thin tail, very expressive, walks on two legs
cast.bear: a big friendly brown bear, round and fluffy, small round ears, a cream-coloured muzzle and belly, kind little eyes, very expressive, sometimes stands on two legs
cast.birds: a little flock of small round colourful birds: blue, yellow and red, tiny beaks, cheerful
